F01.claim: 由于主导破坏模式是粘结面下方混凝土被剪切破坏，极限粘结强度与混凝土抗压强度成正比
F01.section: 2 Previous Research on the Interface Bond
F01.quote: Since the dominant failure mode is shearing of the concrete beneath the bond, the ultimate strength is proportional to concrete compressive strength (f 0 c).

F02.claim: 存在一个粘结发展长度，超过该长度后失效荷载不再增加
F02.section: 2 Previous Research on the Interface Bond
F02.quote: There is a bond development length beyond which the load at failure cannot be increased.

F03.claim: 建议实际设计中尽量延长 FRP 粘结长度，并使用高极限延伸率的胶粘剂，以激活混凝土压碎或 FRP 断裂等其他破坏机制
F03.quote: it is recommended that the bonded length of the FRP be as long as possible, along with the use of adhesives with high ultimate elongation, to promote the use of FRP strength and activate other failure mechanisms such as crushing or rupture.

F04.claim: 较薄胶层降低混凝土-胶粘剂界面发生破坏的概率
F04.section: 2 Previous Research on the Interface Bond
F04.quote: thinner adhesive layers lower the chances of a concrete-adhesive interface failure.

F05.claim: 较薄胶层更有利，刚性粘结层并不理想
F05.quote: The thinner adhesive layers lower the chances of a concrete-adhesive interface failure; thus, stiff bond layers are not ideal.

F06.claim: 使用延性更高的胶粘剂会得到较弱的粘结但更大的失效应变
F06.section: 2 Previous Research on the Interface Bond
F06.quote: The use of more ductile adhesives leads to weaker bonds but larger failure strains.

F07.claim: 现行规范给出的有效粘结长度公式彼此很不一致
F07.quote: However, the effective bond length equations adopted in current codes are very inconsistent.

F08.claim: 目前没有被普遍接受的有效粘结长度解析模型
F08.quote: There remain no accepted analytical models to predict the effective bond length.

F09.claim: 机械打磨或喷砂处理混凝土表面后再涂合适底涂，可获得最佳粘结
